preset.carrier_custom.description: Lab Carrier: provider (jitsi/telemost/wbstream/jitsi_sei), room URL, optional token/key. Prefer a concrete SFU preset when possible.
preset.carrier_custom.title: Carrier constructor
preset.carrier_jitsi_sei_shared.descript: Jitsi + SEI channel transport (shared). Use when datachannel path is filtered.
preset.carrier_jitsi_sei_shared.title: Carrier Jitsi SEI shared
preset.carrier_jitsi_sei_users.descripti: Jitsi + SEI with per-user creds. Same room requirement as other Carrier presets.
preset.carrier_jitsi_sei_users.title: Carrier Jitsi SEI users
preset.carrier_jitsi_shared.description: WG-star underlay via Jitsi SFU, shared auth. Requires room URL. Traffic looks like a video call, not a VPN handshake.
preset.carrier_jitsi_shared.title: Carrier Jitsi shared
preset.carrier_jitsi_users.description: Jitsi underlay with per-user credentials. Stronger isolation; still needs a valid room URL.
preset.carrier_jitsi_users.title: Carrier Jitsi users
preset.carrier_peer_shared.description: Direct peer underlay (self-host), shared auth. No public SFU — you run the peer endpoint.
preset.carrier_peer_shared.title: Carrier peer shared
preset.carrier_peer_users.description: Peer underlay with per-user credentials. Needs peer endpoint params.
preset.carrier_peer_users.title: Carrier peer users
preset.carrier_telemost_shared.descripti: Yandex Telemost SFU underlay, shared auth. URL de salle from Telemost; good when Jitsi is blocked.
preset.carrier_telemost_shared.title: Carrier Telemost shared
preset.carrier_telemost_users.descriptio: Yandex Telemost underlay with per-user credentials. Needs full room URL.
preset.carrier_telemost_users.title: Carrier Telemost users
preset.carrier_vk_shared.description: VK calls underlay, shared auth. Needs VK-specific room/hash params from the provider flow.
preset.carrier_vk_shared.title: Carrier VK shared
preset.carrier_vk_users.description: VK WRAP/DTLS underlay with per-user secrets. Set vk_hash / wrap_password from the join flow; not vk.ru/call cloud.
preset.carrier_vk_users.title: Carrier VK users
preset.carrier_wbstream_shared.descripti: Wildberries stream SFU underlay (shared). Needs room + often token/key params.
preset.carrier_wbstream_shared.title: Carrier WB Stream shared
preset.carrier_wbstream_users.descriptio: WB stream underlay with per-user credentials.
preset.carrier_wbstream_users.title: Carrier WB Stream users
